rationale: C. hiranonis ferments lactate and glucose while using arginine as primary N source. At 0.8 /h growth, 84 mmol C/h input supports 30.4 mmol C biomass plus 53.6 mmol C fermented to acetate, butyrate, CO₂, H₂, and formate. N balance: 18 mmol/h in (16 from arginine, 2 from NH₄) minus 8 mmol/h for growth leaves 10 mmol/h for fermentation products.
